Documenting a route never authorizes it. The charter and code win over a conflicting sheet. No direct provider-to-provider channel exists; route every exchange through the Director.

Platform limitations

  • limitation
    Claude Cowork exposes no on-demand inbound API trigger for a real-time Slack loop; the supported programmable bridge is a Claude Code Routine with an API trigger, and Cowork tasks report into Slack rather than acting as a synchronous adapter.
    source
    docs/provider-setup.html, Important Claude Cowork boundary
  • limitation
    The Routine trigger returns a session URL; completion arrives through the signed callback or a manual owner report, and callback evidence never substitutes for pre-work evidence or any gate.
    source
    docs/provider-setup.html; src/director_orchestrator/callbacks.py
  • limitation
    Live dispatch requires a dedicated callback bearer secret stored only by the orchestrator and the trusted callback sender.
    source
    docs/provider-setup.html
  • limitation
    Owner-reported account context is Claude Max 5x. It is a capacity signal, not an API entitlement, and never proves remaining quota or zero cost.
    source
    docs/provider-capacity-and-authority.html, Capacity, roles, and authority
  • limitation
    The native security issuer is dormant: it needs the owner-installed protected runtime, separate broker and worker identities, and a native claude.ai login before it can sign a receipt.
    source
    docs/native-acceptance-issuers.html
  • limitation
    CLAUDE_ACCOUNT_CONTEXT holds the owner-reported account context string surfaced in the provider strategy; it is informational and never an entitlement, quota, or budget.
    source
    src/director_orchestrator/config.py:provider_strategy

    authority_note
    This repository supplies the typed Director adapter only. A transport, trusted work/context binder, and authenticator must be supplied and qualified by the integrator. No existing host-bridge authorization or enrollment is inherited; a missing dependency fails closed without an OpenAI fallback.
    current_transport_constraints
    • native model, authority, writer, process bounds, budget, idempotency, and returned provenance must be verified by trusted application dependencies
    • one effect-free call; typed output is validated and malformed output fails closed
    • project leadership and native sign-in alone do not make this runtime callable
    • the qualified transport must enforce the packet hard deadline and kill or reconcile its entire native process tree before returning; a Python thread timeout cannot provide process cleanup
    • a timed-out or late result cannot become acceptance evidence; an ambiguous native attempt must be reconciled before any new dispatch

Communication

relay_rule
provider_messages_relay_through_director
direct_provider_to_provider_channels_exist
false
notes
  • Claude receives capability-routed assignments from the ChatGPT/Codex Director; runtime messages pass through the authenticated Director broker with their actual executing provider recorded.
  • The callback is provider-to-Director only; it never addresses another provider or the owner directly.
  • Claude never posts to the Slack thread; the Director relays a concise assignment-correlated summary.

This profile does not change

  • committee voting weights or the immutable denominator
  • runtime permissions or allowlists
  • provider credentials
  • deployments or service state
  • Slack behaviour
  • deterministic policy in src/director_orchestrator/policy.py
